flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService, framework/services/datahive/nricFinUenDataRetrieval/service/{DataHiveUENServiceImpl,DataHiveUENBatchService}, framework/schedulers/MhaDownloadJobsScheduler, cron-schedules-{prod,uat}.properties. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsDhAcraBoardInfo (dhacraboardinfolist), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsChangeOfProcessing/EligibilityService, notice_creation/core/helpers/AutoSuspensionHelper. ocmsadminui pages/Notice/context/NoticeContext. ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. The story asks OCMS to send the company UEN to DOS and receive/update the owner/partner/director particulars based on the date of offence and appointment period. The word 'DOS' does not appear in the code; that DOS = DataHive/ACRA cannot be confirmed from the repo. What exists: the 'DH UEN and FIN' job (also used by OCMS8.2) filters notices with id_type B at next stage RD1..DR3 including DN1, queries the ACRA FIRMINFO and BOARD_INFO views per UEN, and updates the company name and address. The job is off in prod (cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:52; UAT true), so steps that depend on it are Sebagian. Board (director/partner) data is queried but not written to the DB (OCMS-DEV-2026-231), and the query uses neither the date of offence nor the appointment period: no code selects an owner/partner/director by date, and no code makes that person the notice offender. The staff UI only shows the board record with the latest reference_period. A UPL notice from REPCCS/EHT carries no UEN (see OCMS13.1 step 3), so the UEN row has to be filled by another path. The demo_remark mentions Vault: in the repo 'vault' is Azure Key Vault for credentials (AzureKeyVaultUtil, datahive.keyvault.url); connection permission for the App Service: cannot verify from repo. No maintenance ticket mentions this job; OCMS-DF-2026-137 (UEN validation, Closed) is only about the ID format. Consistency note: the OCMS8.2 trace rates the step 'receive/update company name and address' Sesuai for the same mechanism; here the addendum convention is used (a step whose execution is switched off by a prod property = Sebagian), the two need to be aligned.
recommendation: Claim only partly: sending the UEN and updating the company data exist but are off in prod. Selecting the owner/partner/director by date of offence and appointment does not exist and must not be claimed; ask URA to confirm 'DOS' and the rule for choosing the director

steps.step: OCMS sends the offender company's UEN to DOS
steps.detail: The 'DH UEN and FIN' job selects notices at next stage RD1/RD2/RR3/DN1/DN2/DR3 (DN1 is where a UPL notice sits) with id_type B (UEN), offender_indicator Y and no suspension (DataHiveUenFinService.java:235-246), then queries the DataHive views V_DH_ACRA_FIRMINFO_R and _D per UEN (DataHiveUENServiceImpl.java:116,140). The job only runs when cron.mhadownload.uenfin.enabled=true (MhaDownloadJobsScheduler.java:43,100-107); in prod it is false with the comment 'keep disabled until DataHive view names are verified' (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52), UAT is true (cron-schedules-uat.properties:52). The real server value: cannot verify from repo. 'DOS = DataHive/ACRA' cannot be confirmed from the repo (the word DOS is not in the code). A UPL notice from REPCCS/EHT does not bring a UEN row (OCMS13.1 step 3).

steps.step: OCMS receives and updates the company's entity name and address
steps.detail: The ACRA view result (entity name, type, status, registration/deregistration dates, address) is stored through updateCompanyDetails and updateCompanyAddress (DataHiveUENServiceImpl.java:173-174); a deregistered company or a blank/incomplete address triggers TS-ACR (:177-206). The function exists, but its execution is off in prod because of the same job flag (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52), so Sebagian by the addendum convention. Note: the OCMS8.2 trace rates the same mechanism Sesuai; the two need to be aligned.

steps.step: OCMS receives the owner/partner/director particulars from DOS
steps.detail: Once the company is found, getBoardInfo queries V_DH_ACRA_BOARD_INFO_FULL per ENTITY_UEN (POSITION_APPOINTMENT_DATE, POSITION_WITHDRAWN_WITHDRAWAL_DATE, PERSON_IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER, POSITION_HELD_CODE, REFERENCE_PERIOD) (DataHiveUENServiceImpl.java:83, 579-585; batch version DataHiveUENBatchService.java:437-443). The result is only kept in memory: the DB write is switched off (OCMS-DEV-2026-231, 'Post-MVP: review field mappings', DataHiveUENServiceImpl.java:606-610 and DataHiveUenFinService.java:1470-1477), so the particulars are not stored/updated. The UI reads the board table through POST /dhacraboardinfolist (OcmsDhAcraBoardInfoController.java:47), which this job no longer fills. On top of that the job is off in prod. 'Receive' exists, 'update' does not, hence Sebagian.

steps.step: The owner/partner/director is chosen by the date of offence and the appointment period
steps.detail: The board query has no date predicate (only WHERE ENTITY_UEN, DataHiveUENServiceImpl.java:579-585; batch DataHiveUENBatchService.java:437-443). positionAppointmentDate and positionWithdrawnDate are only carried into the BoardInfo object (DataHiveUENServiceImpl.java:597-600) and are never compared with notice_date_and_time (grep: no usage). The staff UI picks one board record per UEN with the latest reference_period (NoticeContext.tsx:869-878), not by date of offence. No code applies an appointment-period rule.

steps.step: OCMS follows up the notice against the owner/partner/director (making that person the notice offender)
steps.detail: No code sets the chosen director/partner as the notice offender (nothing writes to owner_driver from the board data; the board write itself is switched off). The word 'director' appears in the code only as a role in the Change Processing Stage eligibility (EligibilityService.java:50, 241-243) and as a TS-ACR reason 'director/shareholder cannot be identified' (AutoSuspensionHelper.java:61-66). Moving the offender to the director has to be done manually by staff.
